overviewParagraphs: Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf is Northern Vietnam's most expansive golf facility — a 27-hole layout spread across rolling hills that blend parkland character with the natural topography of Quang Ninh Province. The three interchangeable nine-hole loops offer golfers significant variety without the repetition that can come with playing the same 18 holes again.

The parkland corridors provide tree-lined definition and visual intimacy, while the hillside sections open up to broader views and more exposed, strategic play. The combination creates a highly varied round — or rounds — across any combination of nines the visiting golfer chooses.

Located in the Ha Long Bay region, Silk Path Dong Trieu is an excellent pairing with FLC Ha Long Bay Golf Club for a two-day golf experience in one of Vietnam's most scenically spectacular provinces. AGS builds Ha Long / Quang Ninh itineraries combining both courses with bay cruises and overnight resort stays.

curatorBriefHtml: Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf (opened 2025 in Quang Ninh Province) is Sir Nick Faldo’s newest 27-hole championship showcase in Northern Vietnam — an ambitious, rolling hill-and-parkland resort set near the sacred Yen Tu mountains between Hanoi and Ha Long Bay. Measuring 6,858 yards from the Blue Tees (Par 72 across its main championship combination), the layout delivers sweeping forested amphitheaters, immaculate Zoysia fairways, and trademark Faldo green-complex contours.

Having played Silk Path Dong Trieu and stayed at the resort personally, it is already clear this property is a game-changer for Northern Vietnam golf itineraries. Because luxury villas and Legacy Yen Tu – MGallery sit right on its doorstep, touring groups can enjoy true stay-and-play serenity away from city traffic — then reach Ha Long Bay in under an hour.
AGS integrates Silk Path Dong Trieu as a headline stop on The Grand Vietnam Odyssey and our bespoke Hanoi–Ha Long itineraries, pairing it with FLC Ha Long Bay and Dragon Golf Links.

scorecard.verdict: A brand-new 27-hole luxury golf oasis nestled in Quang Ninh province. Features rolling hills, crystal-clear water lakes, and the signature 5-star service of Silk Path hospitality.

faqs.q: What makes Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf one of Northern Vietnam's top new courses?
faqs.a: Opened in 2025 and designed by Sir Nick Faldo, Silk Path Dong Trieu features 27 championship holes across rolling pine hills near Yen Tu, modern luxury resort accommodation on-site, and tour-grade conditioning — bridging the gap between Hanoi and Ha Long Bay.

faqs.q: How far is Silk Path Dong Trieu from Hanoi and Ha Long Bay?
faqs.a: Silk Path Dong Trieu is roughly 90 minutes east of Hanoi / Noi Bai Airport and 45 to 60 minutes west of Ha Long Bay — ideal for a 1- or 2-night stay-and-play stopover.

faqs.q: Where should golfers stay when playing Silk Path Dong Trieu?
faqs.a: You can stay directly on-site at Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf & Villas for zero-transfer convenience, or 15 minutes away at the stunning boutique Legacy Yen Tu – MGallery.

faqs.q: What is the best time of year to play Silk Path Dong Trieu?
faqs.a: October through April delivers crisp, dry Northern Vietnam playing weather (18–26°C) and firm, fast greens. Morning tee times are recommended during the warmer May–September months.
